# Pixelify Sans

- Use: TorchLauncher wordmark on the start animation only (`apps/launcher/src/renderer/src/assets/fonts/pixelify-sans-latin-700-normal.woff2`).
- Source: `@fontsource/pixelify-sans` 5.3.0 (npm tarball), latin subset, weight 700. Upstream: https://github.com/eifetx/Pixelify-Sans
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, copyright 2021 The Pixelify Sans Project Authors; full text in `LICENSE` (also stored beside the font file).
- The font is bundled as an application asset; it is not downloaded at run time and is not modified or sold separately.
